The studio / Backstory

We have
a backstory.

We are a team that approaches communication through the craft of storytelling.

Strategy, creativity and production. Based in Buenos Aires, with experience in communication for brands and audiences across the region.

Our point of view

A story begins
with a point of view.

Our roots lie in writing, film and television. We learned to listen to how people speak, find meaning in a detail and hold attention without losing the point.

Today we bring that craft to brands: from a strategic definition to a campaign, a community or a digital experience.

What drives us

Understand before proposing. Find an idea worthy of the audience’s time.

And care for the work down to its last detail.

We work closely with our clients. We share questions, test ideas and bring together the skills each project needs. The relationship is part of the work, too.
